name: Python
exports_detected: Top-level def / async def without _ prefix (fallback)
description: Respects __all__ as the authoritative export list. Without __all__, detects top-level functions and classes whose names don't start with an underscore. Private dunder methods (__init__ etc.) are excluded.

detection_rules.title: __all__ list (authoritative)
detection_rules.description: If __all__ is defined, it is the sole source of exported names. Both double-quoted and single-quoted strings in the list are captured.
detection_rules.example_code:
__all__ = ["create_auth", "AuthService", "DEFAULT_TTL"]

# Even underscore names are exported if listed:
__all__ = ["_special", "Public"]

detection_rules.title: Top-level def / async def (fallback)
detection_rules.description: When __all__ is absent, any top-level function whose name does not start with _ is captured. Includes async def.
detection_rules.example_code:
def create_auth(config):
    pass

async def fetch_token():
    pass

def _internal():  # excluded
    pass

detection_rules.title: Top-level class (fallback)
detection_rules.description: Top-level class declarations without _ prefix are captured as exports.
detection_rules.example_code:
class AuthService:
    pass

class _Hidden:  # excluded
    pass

example_spec_md:
---
module: auth
version: 1
status: stable
files:
  - src/auth/service.py
---

## Purpose

Handles authentication and session management.

## Public API

| Symbol | Kind | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `create_auth` | function | Creates an auth context |
| `AuthService` | class | Auth service class |
| `DEFAULT_TTL` | constant | Default TTL in seconds |

## Change Log

| Date | Change |
|------|--------|
| 2026-01-01 | Initial |
caveats: Only the top-level __all__ assignment is captured; dynamic or conditional __all__ assignments may not be found.
Nested class definitions (inside another class or function) are not detected.
Decorator-only exports (e.g., Flask route functions registered via @app.route) are included as normal functions.
Type-alias assignments (MyType = Dict[str, Any]) are not captured — only def and class.
